en.hubeali: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the deceased, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Get him to face the Qiblah with the underside of his feet’.
en.sarwar: 2. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn abu Hamzah from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “
I asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a dying person. He said, ‘Make the undersides of his feet face toward Qiblah.’ ”
